### Use case or problem / 使用场景或问题

What task are you trying to complete, and what gets in the way? / 你想完成什么任务，目前遇到了什么障碍？

### Suggested improvement / 建议的改进

Describe the behavior you would like. / 说明希望实现的行为。

### Alternatives or context (optional) / 替代方式或背景（可选）

Include relevant platform or accessibility needs, without personal information. / 可补充相关的平台或无障碍需求，请勿包含个人信息。
